name: Foreclosure Engines
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D fantasy strategy game animated sprite source. True transparent RGBA background. Exactly four full-body poses of ONE original upgraded Brasshollow creature in a perfectly regular 2x2 grid with equal square cells, wide clear transparent gutters. Painterly richly textured fantasy unit art, weathered brass and soot-black iron, warm directional light. Right-facing three-quarter camera; same identity, design, equipment, proportions and scale in all four cells. Full body and all weapons visible with generous 8% margin EACH cell. Same planted feet/paws positions in every cell. Four genuinely articulated idle keyframes reading row-major, visibly different joint and equipment angles; no static duplicate cutouts. No text, caption, watermark, gridlines, checkerboard, environment, scenery, floor or platform.  CRITICAL LAYOUT: make sheet square 1536x1536. Each of 4 cells is768x768. Draw characters substantially SMALLER within cells: subject occupies at most 70% of cell height and width, leave a full100px EMPTY margin on ALL sides of each subject. Nothing may touch outer image boundary or central seams.Creature Foreclosure Engines. Hulking furnace automaton with gigantic articulated claw-press right arm, broad asymmetrical shoulder carapace, dangling brass docket chains, exposed red-orange chest boiler, stocky piston legs and huge iron feet. One arm ends in opposed press jaws, other in heavy five-finger gauntlet. Idle: 1 claw elbow relaxed open jaws downward; 2 claw elbow flexes raising press to waist and jaws close slightly; 3 claw lifted beside torso jaws closed, left fist flexes open; 4 claw lowers halfway jaws opening and left fist closes. Keep fixed body size and planted machine feet, no base or smoke cloud.
